'''Paul Laudenbach''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 3rd at [[January 2001 Fitchburg tournament]] on 20 January 2001 with [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|HB flip]], according to Hayes Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1650">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-21-fitchburg-ma-1-20-01d1650/ fitchburg-ma-1-20-01], DeckTech (Hayes "Hayes" Hunter, 21 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-21-fitchburg-ma-1-20-01d1650/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
